sentinelValues.meaning: The application uses the Default Light Theme.
The application uses the Default Dark Theme.
The application inherits the scheme from the higher-priority level (e.g. Settings).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Defines the color scheme ('light', 'dark', or 'inherited') to use at the application level for the current session.
overloadMerges.note: Added sentinelValues documenting the three literal string values colorScheme accepts; no direction/structure change otherwise.

constraints: Has no effect on forms that already declare their own color scheme; a form-level scheme takes priority over the application-level scheme.
Does nothing on Windows with the Classic theme, where only "light" is available.
